overview_description.description:
Infinite8.ae is MENA's DeepTech leader in AI, Metaverse, IoT, Web3 & Blockchain for Facebook, Amazon, Vodafone, Microsoft, Samsung, Alibaba, TikTok.


We build future-ready Frontier tech solutions for Retailers, Banks, Brands and Big Tech using a range of advanced, innovative Web3 and Metaverse technologies. We design, develop, deploy and maintain scalable technology products through off the shelf, customizable or self-service products & solutions.


We are an award-winning DeepTech development company with an extensive IP portfolio and experience building emerging tech solutions with over 100 products built upon Infinite8’s proprietary platform. 

Based on our IN8 platform, we have created multiple sectorally-based product suites for specific buyer types within the following verticals:


Retail & eCommerce – includes a range of customisable Virtual Stores, Personal Shoppers, Store Assistants, Branded Digital Assets, NFTs, Loyalty Rewards and Virtual Sales Training. Consumer & Luxury Brands, Advertising Agencies, Store Owners, Online Aggregators and eCommerce Platforms – Amazon, Alibaba, Carrefour, Union Coop, Cartier, Dunhill, IWC, Montblanc, Roger Dubuis, Vacheron Constantin 

Financial Services – products include Virtual Banking, Wallet Tech, personalized Banking Advisors, eCommerce Apps, Fractional Ownership & Financial Education, Staff Training for Banks, Insurance, FinTech, Payments, Identities & DeFi 

Industry & Technology – covers Inventory Management, Predictive Maintenance, Carrier Billing, AI Customer Support, Personal Shopping, Collaborative Workspaces & Staff Training – for Software, Telco, Manufacturing - Microsoft, Samsung, AWS, Vodafone, Orange, Etisalat

Sports & Entertainment – offers customisable Virtual Shopping, Merchandise Brand Stores, Arena Visualisations, Ticketing Integrations, Live Sports Feed, Avatars & Animations for Sports Team Owners, Venue Operators, Event Organizers, Concert Promoters
– Facebook, du, SportMob, TikTok, Government of Dubai

Travel & Hospitality – our Experiential Engine offers Virtual Tour Guides, Enhanced Guest Experiences, Virtual Travel Agents, Booking Assistants & Customer Support for Hotel, Restaurant, Airline, Resort Operators

Education & Training – offers Virtual Classes, Immersive Learning, Digital Campus, Classroom Guides, Student Orientation, VR/AR Tutorials, Student Training & Enhanced Learning Modules for any Educational Institution – University of Sharjah

Real Estate & Design – customisable 3D Property Tours, Property Management Controller, IoT Integrations, Smart Home Dashboard (Eco, Energy, Security), Virtual Sales/Client Meetings and Interior Design & Renovation modules for Property Developers, Sellers & Designers

Media – includes 2D & 3D Animation, Music Production, Cinematic Trailers, Broadcast Suite, Agency Suite, Brand Manager Suite, Game & Content Creation teams for Brand Marketing, Content Creators, Sponsors & Digital Agencies – TikTok, Facebook, Pringles, Dubai Police

Gaming - covers A to Z in gaming & app development for both Web2 & Web3, including Game Design, 3D Modeling, Animation, Trailer Production for Gaming Startups, Studios, and Brand Promotions - TikTok, Facebook, KitBlock, Sony Interactive, PlayStation
